recognize_zh: 一顆大型早期紅血球前驅細胞，核圓、染色質細顆粒狀，胞質深藍並有不規則突起（cytoplasmic bleb），可見早期紅系細胞；但本圖明確的發育不良特徵（如核出芽、多核）有限。
features: Large cell with a round nucleus and finely stippled to granular chromatin
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm, deepest at the periphery
Irregular cytoplasmic outline with a budding bleb at the lower edge
No definite nuclear budding, multinuclearity, or internuclear bridging
Background red cells and slide show a fine stippled artifact
describe_en: Smear at high power shows a large early erythroid precursor, consistent with a proerythroblast or basophilic normoblast, with a round nucleus, finely stippled chromatin and intensely basophilic cytoplasm bearing an irregular cytoplasmic bleb. Definite dysplastic features such as nuclear budding, multinuclearity, internuclear bridging or megaloblastoid asynchrony are not clearly demonstrated in this single cell. The background shows a stippled artifact. The image fits an early erythroid precursor, but dyserythropoiesis cannot be firmly established from this field alone.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin in hemoglobinized cells, reversed by vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of such proerythroblasts, often vacuolated, comprising over 80% of cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts.
Parvovirus-infected pronormoblasts are giant cells with glassy intranuclear inclusions and cytoplasmic pseudopods in a marrow depleted of later erythroid forms.
Myeloblasts have paler blue cytoplasm without the intense basophilia, may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO/CD117 positive.
